name: RC-B10-0441/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the undemocratic elections in the Russia State Duma and their implications for civil society
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia's September 2026 parliamentary elections as neither free nor fair. It says the results cannot be trusted, because opposition candidates were blocked or jailed, independent observers were shut out, and voting also took place on occupied Ukrainian territory. The Parliament refuses to recognise the new Russian parliament as legitimate. It calls on the European Union and its member states to avoid official contact with it, to impose sanctions on those responsible, and to keep supporting Russian pro-democracy and anti-war groups.

- **What changes:** No law changes. Parliament states its position and makes requests to the EU and member states.
- **Who it affects:** The new Russian parliament, Russian officials and judges, and Russian activists and independent media.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and member states. They decide whether to act on the sanctions and no-contact requests.
